name: Chocolate "Turkey" Cupcakes with Candy Corn & Pretzel "Tail Feathers" (Cooking with Kids)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe uses Duncan Hines Devil's Food cake mix; if using a different brand please adjust recipe ingredients and cooking times per package instructions.
This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!
TO MAKE THE CUPCAKES: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line two 12-cup muffin pans with paper liners and set aside. (Or bake in batches if necessary.)
Place cake mix, eggs, water, and oil in a medium bowl. Using a hand-held mixer, blend on medium for 2 minutes, scraping down the sides of the bowl as needed.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (432 g) box devil's food cake mix
1 cup water
½ cup neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Fill muffin liners half-full with batter (about ¼-cup each). Place in the preheated oven and bake until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, 19-23 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool completely, about 1 hour.

TO DECORATE THE CUPCAKES: When the cupcakes are cool, transfer frosting to a piping bag with a star tip. Pipe frosting over cupcakes, then have fun decorating your turkeys by adding candy eyes, candy corn as a "beak," and candy corn and pretzels as "tail feathers."
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (454 g) tub chocolate frosting
¼ cup mini candy eyeballs
2 cups candy corn

instructions.primary_message: Show off your creations, share, and enjoy!
